# Excluded from the operator-facing release distribution ZIP built by
# .github/workflows/release.yml. rsync --exclude-from format — one pattern
# per line, '#' starts a comment, trailing '/' marks a directory.
#
# Everything NOT listed here ships in the ZIP, including the freshly built
# (gitignored) resources/assets/ and every file covered by plugin.json's
# signature files-map (plugin.json, signature.sig, composer.json,
# package.json, package-lock.json, vite.config.js, resources/, app/,
# config/, database/, lang/, routes/, README/LICENSE/NOTICE, …) so the
# extracted tree is a complete, signature-consistent extension.

# ----- VCS metadata + CI config (never part of the runtime extension) -----
# .gitignore is deliberately NOT excluded: the signature verifier reads it
# from the extracted tree to know which paths to skip, and without it the
# shipped (gitignored) resources/assets/* count as unsigned extra files,
# which reports the extension as tampered with.
.git/
.github/
.gitattributes
.editorconfig

# ----- Build-time only (assets are already built into resources/assets) -----
node_modules/

# CI staging dir — without this, rsync recurses into its own target.
dist/

# ----- Local dev / handoff scratch (not committed / not runtime) -----
IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md
.phpunit.result.cache
.DS_Store
